rca of the issue: RCA: App code configures CORSMiddleware with allow_credentials=True and explicit origins, but public OPTIONS responses still come from edge/proxy with wildcard CORS headers (Access-Control-Allow-Origin=* and missing Access-Control-Allow-Credentials). Reproduction: OPTIONS {REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL}/api/auth/login with Origin + Access-Control-Request-* headers. Mitigation: align ingress/CDN CORS policy precedence with app settings for credentialed requests.
